_about: Hand-checked corrections, keyed by OneIllinois id (DESIGN 2.6, evidence 5). Each entry names the group (tag.mjs warns if the directory renames it or drops it) and may set: audience ('undergrad' | 'both' | 'check' | 'grad' | 'law' | 'med' | 'vet'; the last four drop the group from the file), kind (a ClubKind), identity (true or false: centered on a shared identity, which decides the folded communities row), goalsAdd / goalsRemove (CAREER_TRACKS / INTEREST_TOPICS ids), subjectsAdd (course prefixes in index.json, for a club about the major whose name does not say so), hide (true: never shipped), starter (true: shown to a student with no goal yet; false: never). Every entry says why in `note`, from the group's own directory page or another source named there. First rows written 2026-10-04. Rows added 2026-10-05 (the step-11 check) were read by hand against each group's own directory text in data/clubs/texts.jsonl, locally, with no new requests; their notes paraphrase it.

36087.name: National Lawyers Guild
36087.note: A College of Law chapter (DESIGN 2.6). The name rules miss it: it says 'Lawyers', not 'Law Society'.

35511.name: American Constitution Society
35511.note: A College of Law chapter (DESIGN 2.6). Nothing in the name says so.

35720.name: Federalist Society for Law & Public Policy Studies
35720.note: Its page describes a forum for law students; the name rules miss it.

35777.name: Guild of Unpaid Illinois Lawyer Thespians
35777.note: Its page says its productions are by students of the College of Law.

37103.name: Pre-Anesthesiologist Assistant Association
37103.note: Anesthesiologist assistants train in a master's program, not medical school (DESIGN 2.6; a known miss in DESIGN 7.1, risk 15). The name reader hears the anesthesiologist and tags pre-medicine.

35452.name: Illinois Leadership Center (ILC)
35452.note: DESIGN 2.6 asked to confirm it is a student organization before marking it a starter. It is not: the directory files it under Student Services & Support, one of the office types, so it is dropped with the offices and is never a starter.

36885.name: Exploratory Students Association
36885.note: A starter club for a student with no goal yet (DESIGN 3.4). Kind academic: the Division of Exploratory Studies' own student group for undecided students; it ticked only Social & Leisure.

37006.name: Campus Volunteer Leadership Association
37006.note: A starter club for a student with no goal yet (DESIGN 3.4). Kind service: its page is about volunteering and leading service projects.

37002.name: Alternative Seasonal Breaks at UIUC
37002.note: A starter club for a student with no goal yet (DESIGN 3.4). Kind service: its page is about service trips over semester breaks and volunteering.

35969.name: International Water Resources Association

36801.name: ACS Polymer and Polymer Materials Science and Engineering Divisions UIUC Student Chapter

36015.name: Laboratory Animal Medicine Club

36081.name: National Arab American Medical Association NextGen at UIUC
36081.note: The name rules read 'Medical Association' as a medical-student group and would drop it, but 'NextGen' is the national body's student arm and its page does not say who joins. Kept, with the check caution, until the reading pass decides.

37014.name: Palestinian American Medical Association at the University of Illinois at Urbana Champaign
37014.note: The name rules read 'Medical Association' as a medical-student group and would drop it; its page describes fundraising, networking and volunteering, not who joins. Kept, with the check caution, until the reading pass decides.

36361.name: Veterinarians as One Inclusive Community for Empowerment
36361.note: Its page names the field of veterinary medicine, not who joins; VOICE chapters are usually veterinary-school groups. Kept, with the check caution, until the reading pass decides.

35837.name: Illini Esports
35837.note: An esports community, per its page; the name reader hears 'sports'.

36231.name: Social Gaming Club
36231.note: A club for casual and competitive gamers, per its page, not game design.

36362.name: Video Game Music Club
36362.note: Performs video game music; not game design.

36169.name: Pre-Genetic Counseling Club
36169.note: Genetic counseling is a health profession of its own; the name reader hears 'counseling' as psychology/counseling/therapy.

36414.name: Animal Welfare Club
36414.note: Its page says it is designed for veterinary students.

37055.name: CarlePride
37055.note: Its page says it supports LGBTQ+ and allied medical students (Carle Illinois College of Medicine).

37091.name: Women in Medicine
37091.note: Its page says it serves women medical students.

35809.name: If/When/How
35809.note: Its page says it organizes law students and legal professionals.

35749.name: Geotechnical Engineering Student Organization
35749.note: Its page says it is a Geo-Institute chapter run by and for geotechnical graduate students.

35893.name: Illinois Biophysics
35893.note: Its page says it supports the biophysics community among graduate students.

36036.name: Linguistics Student Organization
36036.note: Its page says it fosters community among linguistics graduate students.

36093.name: Neuroscience Student Organization
36093.note: Its page says it serves graduate students of the Neuroscience Program (NSP).

36446.name: Chi Epsilon Civil Engineering Honor Society

35722.name: Field and Furrow Agronomy Club

35805.name: Human Resources and Psychology Organization
35805.note: Its page mentions graduate students only as speakers; the text check alone would mark it 'check'. A gold club for the HR persona (p23). Kind pre-professional: its page says it prepares members for careers in human resources.

35914.name: Illinois National Organization for the Professional Advancement of Black Chemists and Chemical Engineers Student Chapter
35914.note: Its page mentions graduate students as leaders and guides of a chapter open to students; the text check alone would mark it 'check'.

37089.name: Afterwards: Arts in Medicine
37089.note: Its page says the medical school hosts it but any student on campus may take part.

37083.name: First Generation and Low Income in Medicine
37083.note: The categories alone (Advocacy, Identity & Culture) read as a cultural group and would hold back its pre-medicine tag; its name says it is about medicine. Identity stays true from the name.

37029.name: Sports and Gaming Project Management
37029.note: Its page is about running projects in the sports and gaming business, not designing games; the name reader hears 'gaming'. Not identity-centered: it ticked Identity & Culture, but its page offers project management practice to any student.

36983.name: Future Women in Sports
36983.note: Its page says it supports women pursuing careers in the sports industry; its categories alone (Athletic & Recreation, Social & Leisure) read as a sports club.

36667.name: Iota Phi Lambda Sorority Incorporated
36667.note: Its page describes a sisterhood of women in business and entrepreneurship: a business sorority, though the name says only 'Sorority'.

36386.name: WPGU-FM 107.1
36386.note: The student radio station; its page says it trains future broadcasters and media professionals. The name reader hears nothing in a call sign.

35788.name: Her Campus Illinois
35788.note: An online student publication; its page says staff gain journalism, marketing and digital media experience. Kind media: it is a publication, not a study club.

35945.name: Illio Yearbook
35945.note: The campus yearbook; its page describes recording campus life in students' stories and photos each year.

35673.name: Design For America at UIUC
35673.note: Its page is about human-centered design projects and teaching that design process.

35674.name: Design Innovation Illinois
35674.note: A design club; its page is about designers working at the edge of technology. A gold club for the UX persona (p20).

36591.name: Product Space UIUC
36591.note: Its page describes product strategy consulting for technology firms and learning product management.

35584.name: Brain Matters
35584.note: An open-access student journal; its page says it covers neuroscience, psychology and biology and runs neuroscience discussions.

36094.name: NeuroTech@UIUC
36094.note: Its page is about neurotechnology, the science and engineering between neuroscience and technology.

35912.name: Illinois Model United Nations
35912.note: Its page is about the United Nations, debate, international relations and foreign policy. A gold club for the pre-law persona (p02).

36835.name: BridgeIllini
36835.note: A multi-partisan group; its page is about political dialogue across the ideological spectrum. Not identity-centered: it ticked Identity & Culture, but its page is about dialogue across political views for any student.

36950.name: Pi Lambda Sigma
36950.note: Its page is for undergraduates drawn to policy, law and government work; it runs career events and brings in speakers who work in government.

36212.name: Security Studies Group
36212.note: Its page is about global security issues and career preparation for intelligence, diplomacy and policy. Kind academic: it ticked only Identity & Culture, which made the category rules call it cultural.

36840.name: I-Public Affairs Committee
36840.note: A lobbying and campaign group for one cause, the United States-Israel relationship. The name reader hears 'public affairs' as the public-policy goal; the planner does not send students to a cause or party group from a career goal (as with the College Democrats and Republicans, which carry no goal). ALMA finds it when a student asks for it.

36739.name: Partners in Health Engage at UIUC
36739.note: A global health group; its page is about health equity advocacy, fundraising and education.

36880.name: Empower Through Health Illinois
36880.note: Its page is about global health and global equity, with mentors, research and fieldwork.

36979.name: United Against Inequities in Disease
36979.note: Its page is about health equity: student research projects on health inequities in the local community.

36850.name: Global Surgery Student Alliance at UIUC
36850.note: Its page is about global health equity, focused on surgical care for underserved populations.

36079.name: NAMI on Campus UIUC
36079.note: The campus chapter of the National Alliance on Mental Illness; its page is about mental health awareness, resources and advocacy.

36638.name: The Gray Matters at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
36638.note: Its page is about mental health education and advocacy and suicide prevention.

36675.name: Psychology Research and Community Club
36675.note: Its page covers psychology research, conversation frameworks drawn from psychotherapy, and mental health advocacy.

35919.name: Illinois Semiconductor Student Alliance
35919.note: Its page is about careers and skills in the semiconductor industry.

37051.name: Mu Sigma Lambda
37051.note: Its page calls it a fraternity that links classroom study with the professional sport industry. Kind professional fraternity: the name does not say so.

37032.name: The Playbook
37032.note: Its page is about leadership and careers for BIPOC students across the sports industry (identity-centered, so it can only appear in the communities row).

36257.name: Steel Bridge
36257.note: The steel bridge competition team; its page is about hands-on steel design and fabrication, civil engineering work.

36672.name: Concrete Canoe at UIUC
36672.note: Its page says the team applies civil engineering principles and races at ASCE events. A gold club for the civil engineering persona (p21).

35706.name: Engineers in Action Bridge Program
35706.note: Its page is about designing and building footbridges with communities.

36000.name: Kinesiology Student Association
36000.note: Its page is for students in kinesiology heading to health science careers. Kind academic: the category rules called it service. No subject added: HK spans Kinesiology and Community Health, and the club is for kinesiology.

36598.name: Climate and Meteorological Association of Students
36598.note: Its page describes a graduate student community in the atmospheric sciences department.

37112.name: Lacuna
37112.note: Its page says it is the medical school's own literary and arts journal, written by its medical students and faculty.

37120.name: Sociolinguistics Association at Illinois
37120.note: Its page says it connects students across academic levels.

35779.name: Hack4Impact UIUC
35779.note: Its page is about building technology for activists and nonprofits; a software project club. A gold club for the software persona (p03).

35588.name: BuildIllinois
35588.note: Its page describes a community of founders and builders with hackathons and startup trips. A gold club for the software persona (p03).

36184.name: Project Code UIUC
36184.note: Its page describes semester-long student software projects in web and app development, data science, machine learning and game development. A gold club for the software persona (p03).

36936.name: Leetcode Club UIUC
36936.note: Its page is about practicing coding problems for software industry interviews.
